pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
The Pale Doll freezes nearby hostile mobs with its Fear Aura, and can shield its owner from a lethal hit in a pinch.

• HP: 120
• Regen IV + Resistance II (no Fire Resistance)

pages.title: Fear Aura
pages.text:
Aura radius 16 blocks:
• Hostile mobs inside cannot target, move, attack, or jump
• Enemies in the aura take +50% damage (x1.5 vulnerability)
• The effect ends when the doll dies or leaves the range

pages.title: Sacrifice Mechanic
pages.text:
When the owner would take fatal damage, the Pale Doll sacrifices itself on the owner's behalf:

• Priority 1: a deployed Pale Doll entity within 16 blocks is killed
• Priority 2: a named Pale Doll Egg in the inventory is invalidated
• Trigger effect: totem-of-undying sound + visuals + temporary 100 HP (lasts 60s)
• Damage that bypasses invulnerability (e.g. /kill, void) does not trigger this

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text:
Surround the center with 8 pale oak logs to craft the Pale Doll Egg.

Name the egg on an anvil, then right-click the ground while holding it to summon the doll.
